items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He said he'd like to have me and Red and Sam and Charlie and Duff -- that was it.

ctx.x: Oh, King's band had a job.

No, no, no. See, Francis Whitby, he stayed in Portsmouth. He was sick. And he wrote a letter and told us that he knew the band wasn't doing nothing, and he had a good job for us. And he kind of wanted to come. He said he'd like to have me and Red and Sam and Charlie and Duff -- that was it. Because we didn't have no bass.
